templateSnapshot.title: Template snapshot rules
templateSnapshot.desc: Changes take effect after you save; existing tasks still use the snapshot from when they were created.

basicInfo.title: Basic info
basicInfo.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what kinds of dev tasks this template is for

workspace.title: Local workspace
workspace.desc: CLI Agents read and write code in this directory; choose or enter an absolute path
workspace.templateDesc: New tasks default to this directory; existing tasks are unaffected

approval.title: Auto-approve
approval.desc: When enabled, CLI Agents run automatically without confirmation

sessionPolicy.title: CLI session reuse
sessionPolicy.desc: Controls how CLI tool sessions are shared across CLI Agents.
sessionPolicy.templateDesc: New tasks follow this policy for sharing CLI tool sessions across tasks; existing tasks keep their creation-time snapshot.

stderr.title: Show stderr output
stderr.desc: When off, hides CLI diagnostics and keeps stdout plus error status only

collaboration.title: Collaboration mode
collaboration.raceWarning: Requires a git repo with a clean working tree; each CLI Agent runs in an isolated worktree.
collaboration.pipelineHint: Continues on failure by default (later members diagnose); user cancel stops later stages.
collaboration.reviewLoopHint: Plan-implement-review plans first, then implements; failed review triggers fixes and re-review.
collaboration.reviewLoopMemberWarning: Pick at least 2 CLI Agents and assign planner/reviewer and implementer roles.
collaboration.customWorkflowMemberWarning: Pick at least 2 CLI Agents and assign the fixer and reviewer roles.

strategies.router: Automatically picks the best CLI Agent for one-off requests.
strategies.sequential: Multiple CLI Agents handle the same task independently; results are shown side by side.
strategies.pipeline: Members work in sequence; later members see prior stage output.
strategies.race: Each CLI Agent gets an isolated worktree to finish the same task in parallel.
strategies.review: Implement, review, and fix in a loop—good for Codex coding with Claude Code review.
strategies.discussion: Multiple CLI Agents discuss plans and risks in rounds on a read-only copy.
strategies.debate: CLI Agents propose independently, critique each other, then synthesize.
strategies.mapreduce: Run the same task in parallel and compare aggregated results

roles.title: Role assignment
roles.desc: Assign who plans, who implements, and who reviews. Planner and reviewer can be the same member.
roles.customDesc: Stages: {{stages}}. The fixer diagnoses and edits code; the reviewer checks the fix quality.

executionDetails.title: Execution details

failurePolicy.title: Failure handling
failurePolicy.desc: Whether to continue later stages after a CLI Agent fails

resultPolicy.title: Result handling
resultPolicy.desc: How to pick among multiple results (currently show all)

executionDetails.hint: Execution details override collaboration defaults. Older data runs fine without configuring this.
